paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Zutra: Gittin 38a. Rabbah bar Zutra: Avodah Zarah 28b. Rav Shmuel bar Zutra: Shabbat 23a.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Gittin 38a paragraph fully names Rabbi Abba bar Zutra; Avodah Zarah 28b names Rabbah bar Zutra; Shabbat 23a fully names Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. These support the separate pointers and local titles, without establishing a common father.
